amendments.reason: The faer partial eigensolver has an unbounded reorthogonalization loop at exact Krylov breakdown and was removed. The shipped initializer in src/standard_umap/init.rs is a bounded restarted Lanczos/Rayleigh-Ritz driver (MAX_KRYLOV_BASIS=64, two reorthogonalization passes, operator budget 5*N per mode, faer EVD only on the <=64x64 projected matrix, residual and orthogonality checked at 1e-7). Genuine budget exhaustion, breakdown or nonconvergence returns UmapError::SpectralConvergence, which only the connected, centroid and large-component boundaries convert into the source-faithful warning plus seeded uniform [-10,10] initialization.
